title: Dinosaurs: Rulers of the Ancient World
description: Discover the massive, terrifying, and amazing creatures that ruled Earth millions of years ago!

questions.q: What does the name 'Tyrannosaurus Rex' mean?
questions.hint: It means 'King' and 'Tyrant' and 'Lizard' - think about a scary ruler!
About as long as a banana! That's huge for teeth.
This dinosaur was like a living lawn mower with hundreds of tiny teeth!

questions.q: What caused the dinosaurs to go extinct 66 million years ago?
questions.hint: Something from outer space crashed into Earth with massive force!

questions.q: Which dinosaur was longer than a school bus?
questions.hint: This long-necked giant could reach leaves at the top of very tall trees!
